summary.text: Priscilla Ghaznavi is an independent candidate running on the Our Future Party line in NY-7. According to her campaign website, she is a designer who has worked for seven publicly traded companies and is a former president of her homeowners association. She campaigns on housing affordability and homeownership, expanded mental-health care, and property-tax relief tied to income rather than market value.

paragraphs.text: Born in Washington, D.C., to immigrant parents from Iran and Bolivia; has lived in New York City for more than three decades, in Chelsea, Greenpoint, and Williamsburg, according to her campaign website.

Holds a bachelor's degree in Marketing with a concentration in International Trade, plus additional qualifications in design, merchandising, and advanced studies in Milan, according to her campaign website; was elected President of New York State DECA during college. Ballotpedia lists associate and bachelor's degrees from the Fashion Institute of Technology.
Describes a career as a designer spanning seven publicly traded companies in business and creative leadership roles.
Served as president of her homeowners association, where her campaign says she stabilized its finances during the COVID-19 pandemic.
Earned a fourth degree, in Entrepreneurship, in May 2026, according to her campaign website; fluent in English and Spanish ("Castellano"), per the same page.
